applies_to: Carrier AquaEdge 19XR single-stage and two-stage centrifugal chillers with the PIC6.1 controller.
summary: The 19XR PIC6.1 controller speaks BACnet MS/TP on RS-485 port J8 or BACnet IP on Ethernet port J15, plus Modbus RTU/TCP. Object names join the CCN table and point name (TEMP_LCW, GENUNIT_CHIL_S_S_wr). Commands use paired read (_rd) and write (_wr) objects; the list also carries temperatures, pressures, bearing and motor data, VFD values and one binary value per alarm or alert code (BV 10000 and up).
notes: Access is taken from the PV ACCESS column: RW objects are listed as writable, RO as read-only.
This is the PIC6.1 controller; the older PIC5 19XR has its own list (19XR-CLT-3T).
The guide says the controller holds up to 500 objects; the table prints 463 (160 AV, 294 BV, 9 MV).
BV 10000-10454 are one flag per alert (ALT-) or alarm (ALM-) code; BV 10000 marks the end of the alarm message list.
No units column; values follow the BACnet Metric Unit setting (bacunit).
Some alarm object names are cut at 24 characters in the guide (for example A_PRO_ALT_HI_EVAP_PRESS_); they are kept as printed.

source.title: AquaEdge 19XR Single-Stage and Two-Stage High-Efficiency Semi-Hermetic Centrifugal Liquid Chillers - Controls Operation and Troubleshooting (Appendix D, Table C BACnet Object Table)

integration.summary: Select BACnet MS/TP on port J8 or enable BACnet/IP in the BMS Protocol menu (Service password), set the identifier and network, and put the chiller in Network control mode. The chiller then starts when both BV 66 start/stop and BV 68 occupied are true; write control point and demand limit through the _wr objects and read status, water temperatures and alarms.

minimum_points.name: GENUNIT_ctl_mode
minimum_points.why: Control mode: Local, Network, Remote, Local Sched

integration.enable: In Network control mode the chiller starts and stops from the CHIL_S_S and CHIL_OCC points written over the network (both must be true). Use EMSTOP for a shutdown. If the Stop Override point in GENUNIT is enabled the chiller cannot start.
setup: BMS Protocol menu: port J8 carries BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU; BACnet/IP and Modbus TCP use Ethernet port J15 (default 169.254.0.1, mask 255.255.0.0).
Defaults: BACnet identifier 1600001, BACnet network 1600, UDP port 47808, MS/TP MAC 1, MS/TP baud option 2 (38400), Max Master 3, Max Info Frames 5.
BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP cannot both be enabled.
Changing a BACnet parameter reboots the board after 1 minute; an IP address change needs a manual reboot or power cycle.
gotchas: Write the _wr objects; the _rd objects only echo the current value.
Alarm and alert flags exist only for the options fitted (VFD, AHF, hydraulic, free cooling and so on).
